responsibility: Declares the RTL scheduler’s data dependence graph interface and core data structures. It defines DDG nodes, edges, whole-graph and SCC containers, the dependency kind enums, per-node predecessor/successor bitmaps and recurrence-distance scratch data, plus the public APIs for constructing, freeing, printing, querying, and analyzing DDGs and their SCCs for loop scheduling.
same_name_distinction: Defines the DDG data structures, enums, accessor macros, and public function prototypes used by the scheduler; unlike gcc/ddg.cc, it is the interface/representation header and does not perform dependence-graph construction or SCC/path analysis itself.
